Then reason: the process sequence in the material is: corn is planted in spring, cauliflower is planted in autumn, producing agricultural waste such as corn stalks and cauliflower leaves; these agricultural wastes are used to raise pigs and sheep; pig manure enters the crab pond and becomes nutrition for planktonic aquatic organisms; plankton improves the water environment, which is beneficial to shrimp and crabs; at the end of the year, pond-bottom silt is returned to the field, enhancing soil fertility.
